text:
alex: FYI — nightly eval (gptx-7b-quant) shows a sharp coherence/regression spike on the legal prompt set at 03:07 UTC.

alex: metrics: normalized quality -6.2%, token-entropy -0.8 bits vs baseline, perplexity +11%.

eval-bot: nightly job finished: https://ci.redwood/runs/192345 — tag: q-coherence-2026-03-20 :mag:

tara: can you paste a short example of a bad generation so we can triage?

alex: example (truncated):
```
Prompt: Summarize the following clause in plain english:
"If the party fails to deliver goods by the date..."
Expected: A concise summary that identifies obligations and remedies.
Got: The clause is about the clause. The clause says that the party will... the clause again.
```

alex: the model repeats phrases, loses referents, and output is more fragmented than baseline.

cheng: I merged an attention commute optimization (PR #4123) yesterday morning — it reorders ops in the fused-attn kernel for perf. It landed to canary only. @deploy-bot did it get promoted?

deploy-bot: PR #4123 deployed to canary at 2026-03-19T10:12Z. Not in stable/prod.

sasha: I repro locally with `--seed 42 --quant 4bit`. Running 50 prompts from the legal set, same staccato outputs and entropy drop.

matt: quick test: try setting `ATTN_COMMUTE=0` in the runtime container config and re-run the prompt set.

sasha: toggled `ATTN_COMMUTE=0` and re-ran; outputs look much closer to baseline. Verdict: change interacts with quantized path + sampling.

tara: ok plan: (1) revert canary ASAP or flip feature flag, (2) add a regression test to nightly to assert token-entropy distribution, (3) add a fuzz for reordered kvcache shapes. Who owns rollback? @cheng

cheng: I'll open a revert PR and a regression test. Drafting revert now, will push in ~30m. Also adding a KS-test in nightly eval harness to compare token-entropy histograms vs baseline.

alex: adding more context: likely root cause = numeric accumulation change when we commute matmuls under quantization + float32 accumulation variance -> affects softmax tail probabilities and sampling ties.

matt: can we get a minimal repro that shows token-prob diffs? If we diff logits before softmax we can see where mass shifts.

sasha: I captured a minimal trace: `model.run_trace(prompt, capture_logits=True)` — attaching snippet below:
```
# snippet from trace
step 12 logits baseline: [..., -1.23, -0.98, -6.1]
step 12 logits commuted: [..., -0.95, -1.12, -6.05]
# small reorder shifts which change softmax top-k in quantized path
```

cheng: thanks. I'll add a unit test that asserts max|cdf_diff| < 0.02 for sampled prompts. Also adding a test under quantized config.

deploy-bot: revert PR #4128 created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4128 — queued for canary deployment.

eval-bot: canary re-run queued.

(eval) 30m later — eval-bot: canary verification complete: 10/10 failing prompts recovered, token-entropy within 1 sigma of baseline.

alex: great. Follow-ups: schedule a deeper numerical analysis workshop to understand accumulation/order invariance under quantization, and add an e2e sampling stability metric to nightly.

tara: also log action items: add pre-merge sampling-distribution check for fused-attn changes, update code review checklist to include quantized sampling stress tests.

maria: SRE note — watching latency during rollback; will alert if p99 > 150ms.

matt: also propose adding a synthetic harness that reorders kv-cache axes randomly to catch these in CI.

cheng: accepted. I'll own the revert verification and the KS-test PR. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

alex: closing this thread — will file a short postmortem and link to PRs and traces. :eyes:
